question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

According to the Finance Minister, this will provide the digital economy a new demension.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"demension"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"dimension".**
 
• **"Demension"** is not an English word and thus has no meaning. (कोई अर्थ नहीं)
 
 
• **Example:** There is no example as "demension" is not a correct word.
 
 
 
• **"Dimension"** refers to a measurable extent of some kind, such as length, breadth, depth, or height. (आयाम)
 
 
• **Example:** The dimensions of the room are 15 feet by 20 feet.
 
 

Therefore, the correct spelling is **dimension**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Provide** (प्रदान करना): To supply or make available.

 
 
• **Example:** The organization aims to **provide** clean drinking water to rural areas.
 
 
 
• **According** (अनुसार): As stated by or in.
 
 
• **Example:** **According **to the weather report, it will rain tomorrow.
 
 
 
• **Economy** (अर्थव्यवस्था): The wealth and resources of a country or region, especially in terms of production and consumption of goods and services.
 
 
• **Example:** The global **economy** is recovering after the pandemic.
